# The monthly run's packages (reharvest.yml): numpy and pillow for similar.py and chart_side.py, anthropic for
# translate.py, and everything they pull in, each pinned with the hash of every file PyPI has for that version.
# pip install --require-hashes --no-deps --only-binary :all: refuses anything else, so no new release reaches the job
# that holds the API key unless it is taken here on purpose. Resolved for CPython 3.12 on linux x86_64 (the runner).
# To take a new release: change the pin at the top of the tree and regenerate the whole file (pip install --dry-run
# --report for that platform, then each name==version's hashes from https://pypi.org/pypi/<name>/<version>/json).
